mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month and the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in > 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month and the 5-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 0.5% in 1 month and the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases > 5% in 1 month and the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% in 1 month and the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month and the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in > 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) combined with a stable or decreasing Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) indicates strong economic growth without overheating, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 1% in 3 months and UNRATE stable or decreases
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases > 1% in 3 months and UNRATE is stable or decreases, but the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in > 60% of the triggered instances.
